title: Global orientation
note: No compulsory GitHub connection or repeated onboarding pitch. The same global baseline remains applicable inside a project, without duplicate delivery.
current: Machine-wide hooks carry SessionStart and prompt delivery outside a project and step aside inside one, so the baseline is delivered once. Outside a project they deliver the rendered orientation (scope, yoke-global next action, status/help pointers, writing rules, optional project folders), and setup installs yoke-global; receipt in a real outside-project session on every harness is not yet proved.
desired: One bounded orientation plus yoke-global; select/add a project, then open a session in its folder.
